iranians_in_germany.label: Persian-speaking residents of Germany
iranians_in_germany.language_hint: fa-IR audience; sources may be German or English
selection_notes: Prefer practical impact on daily life in Germany over geopolitics.
Do not require the article to mention Iran or Iranians.
General German policy, benefits, work, housing, and bureaucracy news can be highly relevant.
Reject celebrity, sports, or distant world news with no Germany household effect.
